title: Point all records/ readers at a worktree of athena/records
summary: Add a managed worktree of the athena/records branch at a fixed path in Athena's state directory, and route every reader of records/ (Records::load, RecordSet::load, read_records, walltime, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection, study site generator) to it. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier; a checkout with no records/ must still run status and forecast.

defaults_applied.how: Equivalence and no-records/ tests; cargo test and clippy clean.
Behavior criteria name cargo test commands.
Criteria compare reader outputs, not existence of wiring.
Docs and decision entries written for outside readers.
Single helper for the worktree path makes the rule structural.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The cutover job (20261025-001232-vesh) has landed, so athena/records exists with C0 and the import commit.
The worktree is created or refreshed (detached at the branch tip) on demand by a single helper in athena-core, and all readers take their records root from it.
When the branch is absent (before cutover), readers fall back to records/ in the working tree so existing behavior is unchanged.
Equivalence is tested in a scratch repository: import records/ at C0, then compare each reader's output from the branch worktree with its output from records/.
The wiring edits live mainly in the listed crates; docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md get short entries.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in the workspace shows each reader (Records::load, RecordSet::load, read_records, the walltime reader, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection, study site generator) returns the same result from the athena/records worktree as from records/ at C0. Run cargo test.
A test runs athena status and a forecast on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/ and both succeed, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test.
The worktree path is a single fixed location under Athena's state directory, defined in one place, and no reader still hard-codes a records/ path in the working tree except the pre-cutover fallback.
Before the branch exists, existing tests pass unchanged: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets, and cargo fmt --check are clean.
docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move and the fallback, citing D111.

out_of_scope: Removing records/ from the main branch
Changing the cutover, importer, or history/attribution checks
departures: Broad cross-crate change touching many readers with a scratch-repo equivalence test; higher cost, time and risk than the reference.
